entries.title: Revelation of John 16:2
segments: Noisome and grievous sore. Like the plague of boils upon the Egyptians.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:3
segments: Blood as of a dead man. See

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:6
segments:
Given them to drink. See Mt 23.34-37.
 

 
 They are worthy. That is, of judgment and punishment.

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:10
segments: Throne of the beast. Satan and his angels are here tormented, as well as his subjects.

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:16
segments: Har-Magedon. That is Mount Magedon, a reference to Megiddon of the Old Testament, especially to the battle in which good King Josiah fell and lasting sorrow came to Israel.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:17
segments: It is done. The declaration of finality, as in our Lord's 'It is finished.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:19
segments: Babylon the great. The world power, the city of the world as opposed to the city of God; doubtless represented to the early Christians by the city of Rome.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:21
segments:
.
 

 
 Weight of a talent. A Jewish 'talent' weighed more than 100 pounds.
